subject.title: feat: add native inline widget support

question: Does the isolated-WebView and capability-URL confinement implemented here satisfy the intended security boundary for running assistant-authored widgets in all three native clients?
rationale: The source and proof support the design, but accepting model-authored scripts in native WebViews is a security-sensitive product boundary whose final ownership cannot be inferred solely from tests and screenshots.

options.title: Approve the native boundary
options.body: Accept the isolated-profile, strict-navigation, capability-scoped design after current-head native checks complete.

options.title: Require stronger isolation proof
options.body: Request diagnostic evidence for profile separation, blocked navigation, capability expiry refresh, and content-process recovery before merge.

options.title: Pause native widgets
options.body: Keep browser rendering only until maintainers choose a different native sandbox or content model.

recommendation.title: Approve the native boundary
recommendation.body: Accept the isolated-profile, strict-navigation, capability-scoped design after current-head native checks complete.

likelyOwner.reason: This person owns the cross-platform implementation and corrected the prior capability-boundary problem on the current head.
